description: This Java source file defines the PermissionDetails activity in an Android application, which displays detailed information about a specific permission including the list of apps that use it. It includes UI setup, data retrieval from PackageManager, and list handling.

classes.name: PermissionDetails
classes.description: An Android activity that displays permission details including permission name, description, protection level, source package info, and list of apps requesting this permission.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves permission info based on intent extras, and populates UI components with permission data.

methods.name: getAppsUsingPerm
methods.description: Finds all installed packages requesting the specified permission and updates the app list UI.

methods.name: createAppList
methods.description: Sets up the ListView with the list of packages requesting the permission.

methods.name: setProtectionLevel
methods.description: Converts an integer protection level into a human-readable string and updates the UI.

methods.name: setTextView
methods.description: Sets text content to a TextView identified by resource ID.

methods.name: showDialogInner
methods.description: Displays specified dialog, typically error dialogs.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Handles dialog cancel events, finishing the activity.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Placeholder for handling list item clicks, such as launching app details.
